subject_uz: oilakredit.uz platformasi orqali beriladigan kreditlarning qaytmaslik xatarini sug'urtalash xizmati

requirements.summary_uz: Sug'urta faoliyati uchun 14-klass bo'yicha litsenziya talab etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: A class-14 insurance licence is required.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi sug‘urta faoliyatini amalga oshirish uchun 14-klass bo‘yicha litsenziyaga ega ekanligi.

requirements.summary_uz: Kredit qaytmasligi xatarini sug'urtalash bo'yicha ish tajribasi ma'lumoti va kamida bitta tasdiqlovchi hujjat.
requirements.summary_en: Information on credit-default insurance experience with supporting documents.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchining kredit qaytmasligi xatarini sug‘urtalash bo‘yicha ish tajribasi to‘g‘risida ma’lumot.

requirements.summary_uz: So'nggi hisobot yili buxgalteriya hisoboti yoki auditorlik xulosasi.
requirements.summary_en: Latest-year financial statements or an audit opinion.
requirements.quote: So‘ngi hisobot yili uchun buxgalteriya hisoboti, Soliq organi tomonidan qabul qilingan QR-kodli ma’lumotnoma

requirements.summary_uz: Birinchi sug'urta hodisasi: to'lovlar 60 kundan ortiq kechiksa.
requirements.summary_en: First insured event: payments overdue by more than 60 days.
requirements.quote: Birinchi sug‘urta hodisasi — to‘lov grafigi bo‘yicha to‘lovlar 60 kundan ortiq kechikishi.

requirements.summary_uz: Sug'urta polisi 100 mlrd so'm (rejalashtirilgan 80 mlrd kreditning 125 foizi) uchun rasmiylashtiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Policies totalling 100 billion UZS (125 percent of planned 80 billion UZS in loans).
requirements.quote: Bunda, ajratilishi rejalashtirilgan kreditlar summasining 125 foizi miqdorida, ya’ni 100 000 000 000 (bir yuz milliard) so‘mlik sug‘urta polisi rasmiylashtirilishi rejalashtirilgan.

requirements.summary_uz: Sug'urta mukofoti E-polis rasmiylashtirilgandan keyin 5 bank ish kuni ichida to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Premium is paid within 5 banking days after the e-policy is issued.
requirements.quote: Sug‘urta mukofoti E-polis elektron shaklda rasmiylashtirilgan kundan boshlab 5 (besh) bank ish kuni ichida

requirements.summary_uz: Sug'urtalovchi hodisa dalolatnomasini 10 kalendar kun ichida tuzishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The insurer must draw up the event report within 10 calendar days.
requirements.quote: Sug‘urtalovchi hujjatlar asosida 10 (o‘n) kalendar kun ichida sug‘urta hodisasi dalolatnomasini tuzadi

requirements.summary_uz: G'olib eng past narx usulida aniqlanadi; talablar "ha/yo'q" tarzida tekshiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Winner is the lowest price among bids that meet pass/fail requirements.
requirements.quote: Takliflar 1-ilovada keltirilgan mezonlarga muvofiq hamda ishtirokchining taklifiga asosan bir bosqichda eng past narx usulida baholanadi.

requirements.summary_uz: Taklif ta'minoti 3 foiz zakalat (boshlang'ich narxning 3 foizi, 210 mln so'm).
requirements.summary_en: Bid security of 3 percent (210 million UZS on the 7 billion UZS price).
requirements.quote: etender.uzex.uz platformasiga e’londa belgilangan 3% miqdorda zakalat ko‘rinishida o‘z taklifi ta’minotining kafolatini taqdim etadi.

requirements.summary_uz: Taklifning amal qilish muddati kamida 20 ish kuni; takliflar e'londan 5 ish kuni ichida qabul qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: Bid validity of at least 20 working days; bids are accepted within 5 working days of announcement.
requirements.quote: Taklifning amal qilish muddati takliflarni qabul qilinishi tugagan kundan boshlab kamida 20 ish kuni bo‘lishi kerak.

flags.quote: Xarid hujjatlarida belgilangan reyting, qayta sug‘urtalash, mustaqillik va boshqa qo‘shimcha mezonlar tasdiqlovchi hujjatlar bilan taqdim etiladi.
flags.explanation_uz: Texnik topshiriqda sug'urtalovchidan reyting, qayta sug'urtalash va mustaqillik bo'yicha "qo'shimcha mezonlar" so'raladi, lekin 1-ilovadagi 12 ta talab ichida ular aniqlanmagan. Ishtirokchi qanday reyting yoki qayta sug'urtalash darajasi kerakligini oldindan bilmaydi va talab keyin belgilanishi mumkin. Bir savol bilan aniqlashtirish kifoya.
flags.explanation_en: The specification asks the insurer for rating, reinsurance, independence and 'other additional criteria', but none of these is defined among the 12 requirements in Annex 1. A bidder cannot know what rating or reinsurance level is needed. One clarifying question should resolve it.
flags.rewrite_uz: Sug'urtalovchi kamida ... reyting (agentlik va daraja ko'rsatiladi), qayta sug'urtalash shartnomasi mavjudligi va ... minimal kapitalga ega bo'lishi kerak; aniq talablar 1-ilovada keltiriladi.
flags.rewrite_en: The insurer must hold at least a ... rating (agency and level stated), have a reinsurance arrangement and ... minimum capital; exact requirements are listed in Annex 1.

documents_needed_uz: Davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganlik to'g'risidagi hujjat va ustav yoki ta'sis hujjatlari nusxasi
Halollik va manfaatlar to'qnashuviga yo'l qo'ymaslik to'g'risida ariza (3-shakl)
Kredit qaytmasligi xatarini sug'urtalash bo'yicha ish tajribasi to'g'risida ma'lumot (4-shakl) va shartnoma, hisob-faktura yoki dalolatnoma nusxalari
So'nggi hisobot yili buxgalteriya balansi, moliyaviy natijalar hisoboti va QR-kodli ma'lumotnoma yoki auditorlik xulosasi
Soliq bo'yicha qarzdorlik yo'qligi to'g'risida ma'lumotnoma
Bankrotlik tartib-taomillari yo'qligi to'g'risida QR-kodli ma'lumotnoma
Texnik topshiriqqa to'liq muvofiqlik to'g'risida kafolat xati (6-shakl)
Reyting, qayta sug'urtalash va mustaqillikni tasdiqlovchi hujjatlar
